The orchestrator sent the rule in a follow-up message; the grader re-graded A2 to PASS, kept its first grade in grade_before_round_rule (FAIL) and recorded grade_other_reading FAIL (the reading in which 'nothing' means no test of any kind ran). No other grade of evals 6 and 7 changed.
